mechanism: Partition the original 16 iid stable variables by their unique maximum; conditional on max winner value z, the remaining15 are iid conditioned on S<=z. No tilt and no KL.
conditional_moments: Derive exact truncated first/inverse moment series from the stable tail expansion and Laplace inversion. No lower cutoff delta is introduced.

series.remainder: First omitted alternating term; adjusted moment ratios are bounded by z^-3/(k+4) and z^-3/k.

omissions: For the lower bound discard z<1 and z>last endpoint. For the upper bound use m>=a>=F/n0 and B_a<=16zI at z<1, and m>=m(U),a<=a0 at z>U.
stopping: Report one-point formula interval and compare with52e-6 and1e-4. No all-domain grid, no top2/3 layer, no new parameter search in this batch.
scope: Lower bound on actualG. An upper enclosure bounds this particular order-max Jensen formula, not actualG.
